jobs.occupation: IT System Engineer – International Industrial Environment
jobs.description:
As an IT System Engineer, you are responsible for the reliability, security and continuous evolution of the IT infrastructure.
 You work proactively and structurally, focusing on improvement and prevention rather than firefighting. 

Your responsibilities include:
  
• Managing and optimizing the Windows Server environment 
• Patch management and vulnerability management (e.g. Tanium, Qualys) 
• Active involvement in IT security and compliance 
• 2nd and 3rd line support for end users 
• Incident analysis through root cause analysis and implementation of structural solutions 
• Participation in IT projects (infrastructure, security, international roll-outs)  
This role is not about “putting out fires”, but about building, standardizing and professionalizing the IT landscape.
 
Team & collaboration
 
You will be part of a small IT team (±3 people), which means:
  
• short communication lines, 
• direct visibility of your impact, 
• a high level of autonomy and trust.  
You will also collaborate with internal stakeholders and international colleagues across Europe.

Must-have 
 
• 4–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure or system engineering 
• Strong knowledge of Windows Server 
• Experience with patching and vulnerability management 
• Analytical mindset with a focus on root cause analysis 
• Structured, process-oriented way of working, including documentation 
• Hands-on mindset combining support and infrastructure  
Languages
  
• Dutch or French as main working language 
• Good command of the second national language 
• English is required for international collaboration  
Nice-to-have
  
• Knowledge of firewalls and networking concepts 
• Experience with Azure / Entra ID / cloud environments 
• Knowledge of Power BI or SQL 
• Experience with Intune or CRM environments 
• Background in an industrial or production environment 
• Experience in international projects

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

Our client is an international corporation and leader in construction. They have multiple sites in Belgium, but maintain a flat structure in their organization.

Statutory Accounting

• Prepare and maintain statutory accounts for legal entities in accordance with Belgian Gaap
• Ensure statutory books and records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.

Tax Compliance

• Prepare and submit corporate income tax returns and related filings

• Support tax audits and interactions with tax authorities

Reporting & Controls

• Ensure statutory and tax deadlines are met in line with group calendars.
• Maintain strong internal controls over accounting and tax processes.
• Prepare statutory data for management, works councils, and group reporting.
• Liaise with business controllers, finance managers, and shared service teams.

Given the complexity of the organization and the challenge of this role we are looking for a candidate with a strong background in accounting and tax. Ideally matching the following criteria:

• min 5 years experience if Chartered Accountant with a tax specialisation
• minimum of 10 years experience if Bachelor's degree in Accounting with tax specialisation
• Fluent in Dutch, French and good command in English
• Knowledge of Belgian Gaap Accounting

• Understanding of strong internal control principles

jobs.description:
Our client, an international company located in the region of Ghent, is looking for an Indirect Buyer & Fleet Coordinator EMEA to join the team.

Jobomschrijving

In this dynamic role as Indirect Buyer and Fleet Coordinator you will have following key responsibilities:

Fleet Management (EMEA)

• Act as the primary point of contact for fleet-related matters across EMEA
• Coordinate with leasing partners and support employees on all fleet topics
• Manage the full vehicle lifecycle: ordering, registration, insurance, maintenance, and returns
• Maintain accurate fleet data (vehicles, drivers, contracts, mileage, renewals)
• Handle damage cases, fines, insurance claims, and country-specific exceptions
• Support employee onboarding with vehicle allocation, documentation, and policy guidance
• Ensure compliance with local regulations, company car policies, and duty-of-care standards
Indirect Procurement

• Manage end-to-end purchasing for indirect categories (services, MRO, facilities, packaging, tooling, professional services)
• Create and maintain purchase orders in line with pricing agreements, lead times, and approval policies
• Source, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to optimise cost efficiency and total cost of ownership (TCO)
• Resolve operational issues such as order confirmations, invoice discrepancies, and delivery delays
• Collaborate closely with Finance, Logistics, Quality, Legal, and Operations to ensure seamless execution
In this position you will report to the SC Manager.

• You obtained a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent
• You have a first relevant experience in fleet management or indirect procurement 
• You have a strong understanding of procurement policies, approval workflows, and supplier management
• You work in a structured way and you 'get things done'
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French is strongly preferred
• You thrive in an international context

Our client is a well-established Belgian technology and entertainment company with over 30 years of history and a leading position in its sector. Operating across multiple European countries, the group combines innovative proprietary technology with a strong customer-centric approach to deliver digital and retail entertainment services.

With approximately 1,500 employees across Europe and nearly 500 employees based at its Belgian headquarters, the company continues to invest heavily in technology, innovation and international expansion. Recent developments include platform migrations, consolidation of international operations and the continued enhancement of internally developed digital products.

The legal department consists of a close-knit team of legal and regulatory specialists working collaboratively across several areas, including regulatory affairs, corporate law, commercial contracts, public affairs and employment law. The team offers a supportive environment where expertise sharing, autonomy and professional development are highly valued.

The company culture is entrepreneurial, dynamic and project-driven. Employees benefit from direct access to decision-makers, significant ownership of their responsibilities and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with tangible business impact.

Jobomschrijving

As Regulatory Officer, you will act as the primary legal and regulatory specialist for the Dutch market.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Serving as a key point of contact with Dutch authorities and regulatory bodies
• Coordinating regulatory interactions in collaboration with compliance, legal and external advisors
• Managing license maintenance, renewals and related regulatory obligations
• Overseeing all statutory notification requirements and submissions to Dutch authorities
• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact on business activities
• Translating regulatory requirements into practical internal processes, controls and guidelines
• Providing legal advice on commercial initiatives, marketing campaigns, partnerships and new product features
• Supporting internal stakeholders on regulatory risk assessments and compliance matters
• Coordinating litigation matters involving customers, business partners or authorities
• Managing escalated complaints with potential regulatory implications
• Advising on terms and conditions, promotional rules and responsible measures
• Supporting customer support, compliance and responsible gaming teams on legal matters
• Ensuring customer-facing processes remain aligned with applicable regulations
• Creating and maintaining internal regulatory guidelines and training materials
• Collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions

• Master's degree in Dutch Law
• Between 1 and 5 years of professional experience in a legal or regulatory environment
• Experience with Dutch law is essential
• Experience gained in private practice, in-house legal departments, regulatory bodies or compliance functions is welcomed
• Fluent Dutch and English, both written and spoken
• French is considered a strong asset
• Strong interest in regulatory and compliance matters
• Ability to analyse complex legal situations and provide pragmatic solutions
• Autonomous while maintaining a collaborative mindset
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment
• Willingness to travel occasionally to the Netherlands when required
• Good command of Microsoft Office tools and digital collaboration platforms

Personality-wise, our client is looking for someone who is transparent, approachable and communicative. The ideal candidate is comfortable acknowledging mistakes, seeks continuous improvement and enjoys working closely with colleagues in a relatively young and dynamic team environment.
